scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/robloxstudio-mcp && npm run build -w packages/robloxstudio-mcp-inspector
scripts.build:plugin:inspector: npm run compile:plugin && node scripts/build-plugin.mjs --variant inspector
scripts.build:plugins: npm run compile:plugin && node scripts/build-plugin.mjs --variant inspector && node scripts/build-plugin.mjs
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:plugins
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/core && tsx packages/robloxstudio-mcp/src/index.ts
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/core && npm run test:asset-security && npm run test:package-contents && npm run test:runner && npm run test:port-isolation
scripts.test:runner: node tests/mcp-http-client.mjs && node tests/managed-studio-session.mjs && node tests/instance-routing.mjs && node tests/auto-install-run-process.mjs && node tests/studio-directory-isolation.mjs
scripts.test:port-isolation: node tests/test-port-allocation.mjs && node tests/test-port-wrapper-isolation.mjs && node tests/studio-test-lease.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:full: npm run test:e2e:auto-install && npm run test:studio:runner && npm run test:e2e:lifecycle && npm run test:studio:parallel
scripts.test:studio:smoke: npm run build:plugin:artifact && node tests/run-with-test-port.mjs tests/run-all.mjs --managed --smoke
scripts.test:studio:runner: npm run build:plugin:artifact && node tests/run-with-test-port.mjs tests/run-all.mjs --managed
scripts.test:studio:event-stream-cycles: npm run build:plugin:artifact && node tests/run-with-test-port.mjs tests/run-all.mjs --managed --test play-cycle-event-stream-regression.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:lifecycle: npm run test:e2e:wsl-process-identity && node tests/run-with-test-port.mjs tests/studio-lifecycle-regressions.mjs
